result.description: Compact fictional desktop accessory designed to expand connectivity for laptops and tablets. The Arc T8 provides eight downstream ports, a braided host cable, and a matte graphite enclosure with status LEDs for power and activity. It is intended for office, travel, and home setups where simple plug-and-play peripheral expansion is preferred.
result.title: Nimble Arc T8 Portable USB Hub
result.title_description: Portable eight-port USB hub with braided cable and status indicators
